milestones.name: Async FastAPI Service Skeleton
milestones.why_added: Establishes non-blocking asynchronous request handling with strict type contracts.
milestones.tradeoff: Requires careful event loop management to prevent blocking I/O calls.
milestones.verification_metric: Sustains 500 req/sec at < 20ms baseline endpoint latency.

milestones.name: Sub-Second Hybrid Retrieval Engine
milestones.why_added: Implements local hybrid search without external API latency or licensing costs.
milestones.tradeoff: Requires dedicated CPU thread allocation for local neural embeddings.
milestones.verification_metric: Retrieval pipeline P95 latency remains under 450ms on CPU.

milestones.name: Distributed Redis Semantic Caching
milestones.why_added: Caches identical and high-similarity queries to bypass expensive retrieval runs.
milestones.tradeoff: Cache invalidation complexity and risk of serving stale architectural roadmaps.
milestones.verification_metric: Cache hit response latency drops to <= 15ms.

milestones.name: Circuit Breaker Fault Tolerance
milestones.why_added: Protects against downstream LLM outages by serving verified static blueprints.
milestones.tradeoff: Requires managing static fallback data drift against evolving requirements.
milestones.verification_metric: Degrades to static fallback in under 10ms upon upstream failure.

milestones.name: Structured Observability & OpenTelemetry
milestones.why_added: Provides distributed tracing and P95 latency breakdown across all subsystems.
milestones.tradeoff: Adds minor CPU overhead for log formatting and metrics scraping.
milestones.verification_metric: 100% of production requests emit structured timing headers.
